zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.does: Decides. The other gods may argue, and do, but the nod is his.
zeus.gift: A decision when one is needed, and cover for everyone beneath him.
zeus.wrath: Treats disagreement as rebellion, and pays it back.

hades.name: Hades
hades.does: Rules the dead, rarely leaves, and is not seen when he does.
hades.gift: Depth, discretion, and no appetite for applause.
hades.wrath: Withdraws past reach and calls it privacy.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.symbols: Herald’s staff, winged sandals, the wayside herm
hermes.does: Carries messages, crosses borders, guides the dead down, and steals when it amuses him.
hermes.gift: Quick learning, new routes, and introductions between worlds that had not met.
hermes.wrath: Restless, glib, and loose with the truth.

hestia.name: Hestia
hestia.symbols: Hearth fire, round altar, the first libation
hestia.does: Keeps the fire and stays with it. Almost no stories are told of her, which is the point.
hestia.gift: Constancy. Things are where you left them, and so is she.
hestia.wrath: Stays put past the point of sense.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.does: Sets the measure: the tuned string, the true aim, the oracle that is never wrong and seldom clear.
apollo.gift: Mastery, clarity, and the long view.
apollo.wrath: Coldness, and no mercy for a flaw.

dionysus.name: Dionysus
dionysus.does: Arrives from elsewhere with wine and a loud following, and loosens whatever was tied.

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite.does: Makes people want each other, and makes them agree.
aphrodite.gift: Ease between people. Quarrels end when she arrives.
aphrodite.wrath: Flattery, vanity, and flight from any fight.

ares.name: Ares
ares.does: Fights. Homer’s gods do not like him, and send for him anyway.
ares.gift: Courage, plain speech, and force when it is needed.

athena.name: Athena
athena.does: Thinks first. She is the god the heroes get when they need a plan.
athena.gift: A clear head under pressure, and a plan.
athena.wrath: Contempt for anyone slower or softer.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.does: Holds the sea, shakes the land, and takes most things personally.
poseidon.gift: Feeling at full strength, and an instinct for what is wrong in a room.
poseidon.wrath: Rage, grudges, and moods that flood the house.

hera.name: Hera
hera.does: Keeps the marriage and the household of the gods, and keeps count of every offence against them.
hera.wrath: Jealousy, and a long memory for betrayal.

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.does: Hunts the high country with her own company and answers to no one.
artemis.gift: Independence, true aim, and protection for the defenceless.
artemis.wrath: Aloofness, and no mercy at the boundary.

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.does: Makes the grain grow, and once stopped it.
demeter.gift: Nourishment, patience, and other people’s growth.
demeter.wrath: Smothers, or withholds, and comes apart at a loss.

hephaestus.name: Hephaestus
hephaestus.does: Makes things: armour, thrones, traps, and girls of gold who can speak.
hephaestus.gift: Craft, invention, and the patience to finish.
